])

# Reverse the XOR to get the expected input
edx = 0x2b
result = []

    # If input[i] XOR dl == table[i], then input[i] = table[i] XOR dl
    char = key_table[i] ^ dl
    result.append(chr(char))
    edx += 0x1f
